extension.summary: Organize favorites and shortcuts into folders for your widgets.
extension.description: MetaFave collects favorites and shortcuts from anywhere in Kodi into your own folders and nested folders, preserving each item's artwork, metadata and destination. Every folder can be used directly as a widget source. Use "Add to MetaFave" from any context menu, then organize, copy, edit and repair your collections inside the add-on.
extension.disclaimer: MetaFave stores shortcuts only. Deleting an entry never affects the original media or source content.
extension.news: v1.0.2 - Screenshots added to the README and the add-on information page. v1.0.1 - Set folder artwork from the folder's own contents: "From Items in This Folder" in Edit Artwork, and "Use as Artwork for (folder)" on items and subfolders.
